intro_zh: 战斗最让人疲惫的，有时不是判断打谁，而是在选单位、切模式、展开军队之间反复点按钮。「微操大师常凯申」围绕这些战术操作做减法。下面分清两部分：工坊实验版已有的快捷操作，以及仍在开发验收的 0.6.0 新战术流程。
intro_en: Sometimes the tiring part of combat is not deciding what to attack, but repeatedly selecting units and switching modes. I made this mod to reduce that overhead. Workshop currently has the experimental 0.5.1 release under War Controls; the newer Micromanagement Master 0.6.0 workflows described below are still in development and acceptance testing.
limits_zh: 这是战术操作辅助，不会替你自动决定战争。0.6.0 集火及连续操作尚未作为当前工坊正式功能确认；新集火限单人、合法远程攻击，不覆盖近战、空军或所有第三方战斗触发。已有 Mac 实机记录只证明部分战斗和指挥官行动力流程，不能代表全部组合。
limits_en: This is tactical input assistance, not an AI deciding your wars. The 0.6.0 volley and selection workflows are not confirmed as part of the current Workshop release. The new volley system targets legal ranged attacks in single-player, not melee, aircraft or every third-party combat trigger. Existing Mac checks verify particular combat and commander-movement cases, not every combination.

sections.zh: 选中远程单位，直接准备瞄准
sections.en: Select a ranged unit, ready to aim
sections.pain_zh: 单位明明有合法目标，却还要再按一次攻击按钮，才进入真正想要的操作。
sections.fix_zh: 满足移动力和合法目标条件时，选中远程单位就进入攻击目标模式。最后攻击谁、是否开火仍由你确认；没有目标时不会凭空射击。
sections.pain_en: A ranged unit has a legal target, but selecting it still leaves another mode-switching click before you can aim.
sections.fix_en: When the required movement and legal targets are present, selection enters attack-target mode. You still choose the target and confirm the attack; selection alone does not fire.
sections.shot: 已发布实验版选中远程单位后的合法目标高亮，尚未攻击。

sections.zh: 归队操作，少一次模式切换
sections.en: Make joining a commander more direct
sections.pain_zh: 想让部队加入旁边的指挥官，却容易把同一格上的其他单位或移动操作点出来。
sections.fix_zh: 在支持的情形中优先进入加入指挥官模式，右键指挥官所在格也会优先尝试归队；非法归队不会悄悄变成移动。已有攻击等模式时，先退出当前模式，再进行下一步。
sections.pain_en: Trying to join a nearby commander can turn into selecting another unit on the tile or issuing the wrong movement order.
sections.fix_en: Supported cases prioritize joining mode, and right-clicking a commander tile can prioritize joining over movement. An illegal join does not silently become a move. An existing action mode is cancelled before the next operation.
sections.shot: 归队成功后指挥官编组显示新单位；正文需保留右键是鼠标路径，不暗示同按钮适用于手柄。

sections.zh: 挑一支部队展开，不必展开整军
sections.pain_zh: 只想让一支远程单位出来占位，却被整个军队的展开流程打断。
sections.fix_zh: 选中指挥官内的单个单位后，可以直接进入它的合法展开模式。你选择落点，模组不替你把整支军队自动铺开。
sections.pain_en: You want one packed unit in a particular position, not an entire army deployed at once.
sections.fix_en: Selecting an individual packed unit can enter that unit’s legal deployment mode. You choose the tile; the mod does not automatically deploy the whole army.
sections.shot: 单个打包单位的可展开格与最终落点，主图采用展开后仍清晰可见的单位。

sections.zh: 看清空编组，处理简单增援
sections.en: Spot empty commanders and simpler reinforcement choices
sections.pain_zh: 空指挥官和满编指挥官挤在一起不好辨认；只有一个合法归属时，还要重复选择也显得多余。
sections.fix_zh: 空编组用粉色底座区分，仍在路上的增援不算已经入队。只有一个指挥官且增援合法时可直接处理；有多个指挥官时仍保留选择，避免替你猜。
sections.pain_en: Empty commanders are easy to miss, while a reinforcement with only one valid commander can involve unnecessary selection.
sections.fix_en: A pink base marks an empty commander, without counting reinforcements still en route. A sole legal commander can be handled directly; multiple commanders still require a choice.
sections.shot: 空指挥官粉色底座与普通编组同屏；不要用 UI 模拟图。

sections.zh: 展开和射击之后，继续选下一支
sections.en: Keep selection moving after deployment or an attack
sections.pain_zh: 一支展开完，再回头找指挥官；一支打完，再去找下一门炮。重复选择消耗了战斗的大量时间。
sections.fix_zh: 0.6.0 开发版尝试保留指挥官焦点，继续寻找可展开单位；手动攻击后，再选择同指挥官、同类且仍有合法目标的远程单位。它只衔接选择，不替下一支部队自动开火。
sections.pain_en: After deploying a unit you find the commander again; after firing, you hunt for the next eligible ranged unit.
sections.fix_en: The 0.6.0 development build retains commander focus for eligible deployments and can select the next eligible same-type ranged unit from that commander after a manual attack. It advances selection, not the next attack.
sections.shot: 开发版攻击后下一支合法远程单位已选中；需回合与单位记录证明没有自动第二次攻击。

sections.zh: 先看清参与者，再确认一次集火
sections.pain_zh: 多个远程单位集中打一个目标时，最怕没看清谁会开火、谁需要保留行动。
sections.fix_zh: 0.6.0 开发中的驻地集火会显示参与单位和指向目标的预览，并允许临时排除单位。确认后逐次检查合法性；目标死亡就停止，不自动移动追击。实际开火时才按规则消耗指挥官剩余行动力，取消预览不扣。
sections.pain_en: When several ranged units share a target, you need to know who will fire and who should retain their action.
sections.fix_en: The developing 0.6.0 stationary volley shows participating units and target previews, with temporary exclusions. Each shot is rechecked and the sequence stops when the target dies, without moving to chase it. Commander movement is spent when firing begins, not when a preview is cancelled.
sections.shot: 开发版集火预览：参与单位金色状态、目标红箭头、一个排除单位；另留实际射击日志。

sections.zh: 增援目标先预览，不把无效目标换成别处
sections.pain_zh: 预期增援到一个位置，系统却因为它不可用而悄悄选了另一个，结果比多点一下更麻烦。
sections.fix_zh: 0.6.0 的增援预览保留候选目标，包括暂时无效的目标；可以切换查看，无效时确认按钮不可用，不自动改投别处。手柄切换也纳入这个开发流程，完整实机体验仍待验收。
sections.pain_en: A silent fallback to a different reinforcement destination can be worse than an extra click.
sections.fix_en: The 0.6.0 preview keeps candidate destinations visible, including invalid ones. You can browse them, but confirmation is disabled for an invalid target rather than redirecting the order. Controller browsing is part of this development work and still needs full in-game acceptance.
sections.shot: 开发版无效候选目标显示原因且确认禁用，切换控件可见。

approval: 既有手柄文章已授权发布；本次其他新稿等待用户验收，不发布。
